summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, reporting a press release announcing its participation in two upcoming investor conferences: the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, 2026, and the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 16, 2026. Management will present and hold one-on-one meetings. The release also provides background on SAT-3247, its Duchenne muscular dystrophy drug candidate. This is a routine corporate communication, not a special situation event.
